scripts.build: npm run test:reviews && npm run test:releases && npm run test:trace && next build
scripts.test:reviews: tsc lib/review-command.ts --target ES2022 --module commonjs --lib ES2022,DOM --strict --skipLibCheck --outDir .review-tests && node --test tests/review-command.test.mjs
scripts.test:releases: tsc lib/release-command.ts --target ES2022 --module commonjs --lib ES2022,DOM --strict --skipLibCheck --outDir .release-tests && node --test tests/release-command.test.mjs tests/release-readiness.test.mjs
scripts.test:trace: tsc lib/trace-scope.ts lib/traceability.ts lib/pagination.ts --target ES2022 --module commonjs --lib ES2022,DOM --strict --skipLibCheck --outDir .trace-tests && node --test tests/trace-scope.test.mjs tests/pagination.test.mjs
